children.title: Abuse report submitted
children.summary: An event indicating that an abuse report was submitted in Meet.

children.title: Broadcast activity
children.summary: An event indicating that there was broadcast activity in Meet.

children.summary: An event indicating that an endpoint left a meeting.

children.title: Livestream watched
children.summary: An event indicating that a viewer watched a livestream in Meet.

children.summary: An event indicating that an endpoint dialed out.

children.summary: GET https://admin.

children.title: In meet broadcast activity
children.summary: An event indicating that there was an in-meet broadcast activity.

children.title: In-call messages visible to all
children.summary: An event indicating that everyone in the call can see chat messages.

children.title: In-call messages visible to participants
children.summary: An event indicating that in-call participants can see chat messages.

children.title: Invitation sent
children.summary: An event indicating that an endpoint invited users to the meeting.

children.title: Knocking accepted
children.summary: An event indicating that an endpoint accepted knocking of other users.

children.title: Knocking denied
children.summary: An event indicating that an endpoint denied knocking of other users.

children.title: Only contributors can send in-call messages
children.summary:
An event indicating that sending chat messages is restricted to contributors, hosts, and co-
hosts.

children.title: Only hosts can send in-call messages
children.summary: An event indicating that sending chat messages is restricted to hosts and co-hosts.
